objective: Determine whether frozen T1-M2 semantic information is materially more accessible in fixed internal spatial states of the exact frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 than in its final projected normalized patch tokens.

readers.P0: task-independent learned 24-D query over shared 24-D key/value patch projections
readers.P1: one frozen-language-conditioned 24-D query over shared 24-D key/value patch projections
readers.state: [24-D attended value,24-D mean value,2-D attention center,1-D normalized entropy] = 51-D

training.temperature_objective: demo34 ordinary local pairs plus both correct- and alternate-language counterfactual applications
training.feature_standardization: per-layer token mean/std from demo31--33 only; language mean/std over the fixed ten-language matrix

validation.ordinary: all frozen demo34 T1 pairs with gap<=8
validation.counterfactual: all frozen demo34 correct/alternate language applications
validation.cross_demo: source demo34 against deterministic cyclic demo31 reference

selection.eligible: P1 at each fixed extraction point
lexicographic: minimize same-referent mean abs probability change
prefer later/simpler frozen extraction when all preceding values are exactly tied

diagnostic_probes.common: independently trained P1 single-slot encoder with a linear or scalar head; fit demo31--33 and test demo34; diagnostic only

referent.task: same-scene language-pair classification of whether persistent referent identity changes
referent.input: same frozen visual state under two real language embeddings; symmetric [abs(r1-r2),r1*r2] features
referent.label: G2 same versus different physical referent; never bowl1/bowl2 direction

M2.task: pairwise M2 ordering when official goal Booleans match and abs(delta M2)>epsilon
M2.head: scalar linear state score and Bradley-Terry difference
M2.good: demo34 ordinary accuracy>=0.65 and explicit cross-demo accuracy>=0.65

goal_boolean.task: balanced official On classification and cross-demo goal-change ordering
goal_boolean.head: linear state classifier
goal_boolean.loss: positive-class-weighted BCE with weight fixed from demo31--33 state rows
goal_boolean.good: demo34 AUROC>=0.80 and cross-demo goal-change accuracy>=0.60

interpretation.A: referent good, M2 good, primary value poor -> fusion/readout bottleneck
interpretation.B: referent good, M2 poor -> relational geometry not retained
interpretation.C: referent poor, at least one other probe good -> object-specific language grounding not retained
interpretation.D: referent, M2, and official-goal probes all poor -> representation insufficient

forbidden: change T1-M2, G2, epsilon, pair labels, split, or counterfactuals
test any CLIP transformer layer outside the seven fixed extraction points
fine-tune CLIP, LoRA, or add an encoder adapter
use masks, boxes, G2 identity, M2, On, pose, proprio, task ID, time, or demo ID as a primary reader input
run alternate encoder before a mechanical Stage-I failure
run Stage V before a representation pass
run real candidates, World Model, reranker, controller, or task success
